native_to_julia_mapping.reason: All five stages source-faithful linear-lane semantics; physical flattening, mixed scratch arena and neutralized unconsumed undefined reads disclosed. Original field/masks/observable summaries unchanged.

keyconfounds: The original program emits counts, a scheduling-dependent vertex-index checksum and four partial-coordinate sums; no vertex/triangle mesh arrays exist. Numeric observable equivalence does not certify a valid mesh.

Source-derived topology counterexample finds995 out-of-range local triangle-index references per y-replica. Original boundary edge masks are preserved, not repaired; exclude valid-mesh/scientific-fidelity aggregates. This is a logical source witness, not an observed GPU array-access failure.

Actual field uses x,z,z and ignores y. Nominal N1024 fixes coordinates; source floor block grids cover x/y through1020 and z through1008 at preprocessing level, not a complete1024³ sampled volume. No application surface dataset or geometric accuracy study.

Timer includes only generatingTriangles launch plus synchronization. All four preceding GPU stages, compaction count transfers, allocation, CPU checks, canonical sorting/serialization and normalization are outside the timed region. Untimed preprocessing durations are diagnostic, not part of primary runtime.

Source global Float32 coordinate atomics are order dependent. A predefined1e-3 absolute tolerance is applied to normalized partial sums (divide by exact vertexcount), not full geometric coordinates. Integer IDs and counts separately audited exact. Global vertex-index checksum also changes with atomic block ordering and is retained raw, excluded from deterministic acceptance.

CUDA.jl/KA/JACC flatten physical blocks while preserving original linear lane/warp order and reconstructed source coordinates. Native retains16x16,16x25 and4x4x8 physical shapes. Scratch is packed UInt32 arena1412B with UInt16/Float32 aliases; unconsumed scratch/corner reads are neutralized. Compiler alignment, generated registers/spills and occupancy are unknown.

JACC shared templates add zero-source loads and one barrier per shared kernel. Explicit shared bytes256/128/0/128/1412 for stages1..5; no default49152B policy. Actual dynamic/static allocation and source split-array padding may differ.

KA/JACC use source CUDA shuffles, atomic_add!, sync_threads and typed device-pointer views: hybrid CUDA backend device extensions. CUDA.jl uses its own native APIs and is framework_device_kernel. This does not establish another backend or CPU portability.

Current reference restores a five-kernel historical touch/PASS stub and owns shared semantic-helper drafting; two reference B4 constructor repairs and early missing-fixture T1 kept separate. Each target first candidate/check reuses those audited helpers. No global first-program-success claim or exclusive billed-token ranking.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Intended parallel marching-block isosurface construction; actual source reports topology counts and scalar properties of an extruded implicit polynomial instead of emitting a mesh.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: f(x,y,z)=1-16*X*Z²-4*(X²+2Z²), X=(x-512)/512,Z=(z-512)/512; iso=Float32(-0.9). Hierarchical min/max pruning, prefix-scan compaction, lookup-table cube cases, edge interpolation and atomic summary accumulation.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Nominal1024 lattice,68x68x16 coarseblocks of16x16x64 and340x340x144 fineblocks of4x4x8 with overlapping strides15/15/63 and3/3/7. Source masks disagree with X/Z edge ownership; full mesh connectivity is not certified.
invariants: All four independently reproduced counts exact:8296/240380/4856560/6101640.
Both full sorted active-ID arrays and all preprocessing min/max values verified against independent CPU scans.
All outputs finite; normalized partial-coordinate sums within fixed1e-3.
Source-derived local-index witness explicitly retained rather than masked by native PASS.
accuracy_requirements: All401053 serialized values per model/trial include4401 exact input-prefix values, full147968 Lv1 min/max values,8296 Lv1 IDs,240380 Lv2 IDs,4counts,4normalized partial-coordinate sums.
All3733200 Lv2 min/max entries additionally CPU checked each trial outsideclock; observedmaxerror2.3841858e-7.
CPU oracle independently reduces y-invariant field but GPU primary pipeline executes all original five stages.
No full vertex/triangle coordinates or mesh-array evidence exists; source integer checksum is nondeterministic across atomic scheduling.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 field classification/interpolation near iso; warp Float32 extrema and large global atomic sums. IDs, localindices andcounts use UInt32/UInt16; checksumUInt64. Fullgeometry/surface-error metric absent.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Original N1024 andiso-0.9, all original activecounts; one generated frame per trial, five inprocess trials with explicit complete-pipeline warmup. Other isovalues/sizes and corrected ownership unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Hierarchical implicit-surface visualization/extraction motif, source-defined extruded polynomial only; no independently valid mesh/application dataset claim.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Actual emitted observables weak for scientific geometry; topology defect is known, source field differs from its nominal x/y/z intent, generated spatial coverage is cropped by source floor grids.
